response.content:
The query "companies launched in the UK in 2026" is very broad — thousands of companies are incorporated in the UK every year. Based on available information, here are some notable highlights from the UK startup and company landscape in 2026:

## Notable UK Startups and Company Activity in 2026

- **Fractile** — A London- and Bristol-based AI chip startup developing chips to improve AI inference. In November 2026, it reached a **$7 billion valuation** in a new funding round, with UK government backing.

- **Swap** — A London-based AI-powered ecommerce platform helping brands manage global operations. Founded in 2022, it raised **$100 million in January 2026** (following a $40 million Series B), bringing total funding to $149 million. Ranked #9 in Sifted's 2026 AI 100.

- **Lupa** — A London-based AI-native veterinary technology company. Founded in 2023, it raised a $20 million Series A in late 2025 and was ranked #38 in Sifted's 2026 AI 100.

- **Mimic** (#23) and **Orbio** (#62) — Also London-linked startups recognised in Sifted's 2026 AI 100 list of Europe's most promising AI-native companies.

## Broader UK Startup Ecosystem in 2026

- UK startup funding has been on a strong trajectory: funding reached **$26.1 billion in 2025**, and in the first nine months of 2026, **$23.4 billion** had already been raised.

- A **£500 million fund** was launched in April 2026 to back early-stage AI companies in the UK.

- **Innovate UK** launched new grant funding (£10 million) for aviation companies working on dual-use technology, and a separate £5 million pot for counter-UAS technology.

If you're looking for a specific sector, funding stage, or type of company launch, feel free to narrow your question and I can provide more targeted results.

LONDON, Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Two London startups backed by European early-stage venture capital firm 2100 Ventures have been recognised in Sifted's 2026 AI 100, which ranks Europe's most promising AI-native startups. Swap ranks #9 and Lupa #38, among four 2100 Ventures portfolio companies to make this year's list.

2100 Ventures founders Andrea Gennarini (left), Alessandro Benetton (centre) and Andrea Casasco (right)

2100 Ventures founders Andrea Gennarini (left), Alessandro Benetton (centre) and Andrea Casasco (right) [...] London-based Swap, which ranks #9 in the AI 100, provides an AI-powered platform helping ecommerce brands manage and grow their global operations. Founded in 2022, the company raised $100 million in January 2026, following a $40 million Series B, bringing its total funding to $149 million.

Lupa (#38) is a London-based, AI-native veterinary technology company developing software to modernise veterinary practice management by automating administrative tasks, clinical documentation and client communications. Founded in 2023, the company raised $4 million in seed funding in January 2025 from investors including firstminute capital, 2100 Ventures and Vento by Exor Ventures. In October 2025, Lupa announced a further $20 million Series A, bringing its reported total funding to $25 million. [...] 2100 Ventures has also been named the only Italian investor among Sifted's Top 50 investors and lenders behind the AI 100, ranking #28 overall, with twice as many portfolio companies represented as last year. The recognition highlights the firm's role in identifying and supporting emerging European technology businesses as they develop and scale.

Alongside Swap (#9) and Lupa (#38), the other 2100 Ventures-backed companies recognised are Mimic (#23) and Orbio (#62).

More than 1,500 eligible companies were considered for Sifted's 2026 AI 100, which covers AI-native startups valued under $1bn, with companies assessed on market opportunity, competitive differentiation and momentum.
